input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The agreement meets our preferred position: no minimum commitment, fees for ordered/usage services only. § 2.1 (p0012) expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms that declining to place further orders is not a breach or shortfall. § 7.1 (p0026) bars Vendor from imposing minimum-use or similar charges not identified in the Order Form, and § 12.3 (p0050) records that Customer has made no minimum-volume (or exclusivity/MFC) commitment. "Order Form" (§ 1.6) covers only quantities Customer actually signs for, so no take-or-pay is imported at the Order Form level, and no shortfall penalty, forecast obligation, or non-cancellable/prepaid-forfeiture language appears elsewhere (the only "shortfall" references, §§ 22.2–22.3, concern audit underpayments, not volume). Auto-renewal in § 8.2 extends term length rather than creating a purchase commitment and is addressed by the separate renewal rule. No redline needed.
